append_metrics.name: Datacenter VCSEL market share (revised)
append_metrics.description: Revised estimate: Philips Lumileds datacenter VCSEL/photodiode presence is smaller than previously stated. Primary focus remains on general optoelectronics rather than high-speed datacom VCSELs. Market estimate 2024–2025; low confidence basis.

node_patches.append_notes: Lumileds' role in high-speed datacenter VCSELs is limited compared to Broadcom and Coherent/II-VI. Primary exposure is to general optoelectronics, not the cutting-edge datacom VCSEL market. The 20% share estimate from round 1 is not well-founded. Recommend monitoring; if no clear investor-relevant datacenter VCSEL business emerges, consider removing this org node from the transceiver supplier list.
